calvino_source.inner_arch: Nothing happens in the one Valdrada without being repeated in the other, so inhabitants never succumb for a single moment to chance or forgetfulness. Yet the twin cities are NOT symmetrical or equal: at times the mirror increases a thing's value, at times denies it. Every face and gesture above is answered from the mirror by a face and gesture inverted point by point. The two Valdradas live for each other, their eyes interlocked; but there is no love between them.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Catoptric split-elevation architectural diptych & asymmetric ontological value ledger across an exact horizontal lake waterline, coupled with melodic/phase-inverted WebAudio canons and archival copperplate/tempera plates.
anti_trude_vector.interaction_loop: Inspecting or triggering any of the 7 stacked veranda chambers/parapets above or their reflected twins below enacts the gesture above (warm travertine/amber) and its point-by-point inverted twin below (chilled slate/silverpoint/crimson), updating the Asymmetric Value Ledger (INCREASED vs DENIED ontological weight), sounding a two-voice phase-inverted musical canon across D4, and proving zero chance/forgetfulness and zero mutual love despite interlocked eyes.
